newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC revises down barley stock forecast.
newsitem.headline: ONIC revises down barley stock forecast.

text.p: French cereals office ONIC on Wednesday revised down its carryover stock forecast for barley in an unexpected move accompanied by higher than anticipated exports to EU countries.

The agency said in a monthly report it now forecast carryover stocks of 829,000 tonnes compared with a previous projection of 905,000 tonnes. It projected exports to the EU in the year to June 30 of 2.455 million tonnes, up from 2.37 million forecast in April.
Grain industry sources had previously said ONIC had drafted new estimates of 939,000 tonnes for stocks and 2.345 million for EU trade. There was no immediate explanation for the change.

Also in its report ONIC raised its projection for soft wheat stocks on June 30 by 99,000 tonnes and cut its forecast for maize stocks by 115,000 tonnes. These changes were in line with market expectations. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5146 (c) Reuters Limited 1997
